endorsements.name: Eduardo Maragno
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-1086
endorsements.description: A vulnerability has been found in Safetytest Cloud-Master Server up to 1.1.1 and classified as critical. This vulnerability affects unknown code of the file /static/. The manipulation leads to path traversal: '../filedir'. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 4.0, 6.9)

endorsements.name: Eduardo Maragno
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-1105
endorsements.description: A vulnerability was found in SiberianCMS 4.20.6. It has been rated as problematic. Affected by this issue is some unknown functionality of the file /app/sae/design/desktop/flat of the component HTTP GET Request Handler. The manipulation leads to cross site scripting. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 4.0, 5.3)
